56600.commentary: (ANa) saṅkapparāgo'ti saṅkappavasena uppannarāgo. (SNa) saṅkapparāgo'ti saṅkappitarāgo. evam'ettha vatthukāmaṃ paṭikkhipitvā kilesakāmo kāmo'ti vutto.

examples.text: kāyaviññeyyā phoṭṭhabbā iṭṭhā kantā manāpā piyarūpā kām'ūpasaṃhitā rajanīyā. api ca kho, bhikkhave, n'ete kāmā kāmaguṇā nām'ete ariyassa vinaye vuccanti. saṅkapparāgo purisassa kāmo.
n'ete kāmā yāni citrāni loke, saṅkapparāgo purisassa kāmo, tiṭṭhanti citrāni tath'eva loke. ath'ettha dhīrā vinayanti chandan'ti.
kim'ārammaṇā, samiddhi, purisassa saṅkappavitakkā uppajjantī'ti? nāmarūp'ārammaṇā, bhante'ti. te pana, samiddhi, kva nānattaṃ gacchantī'ti? dhātūsu, bhante'ti.
santaṃ'y'eva pana paraṃ lokaṃ n'atthi paro loko'ti'ssa diṭṭhi hoti, s'āssa hoti micchādiṭṭhi. santaṃ'y'eva kho pana paraṃ lokaṃ n'atthi paro loko'ti saṅkappeti, sv'āssa hoti micchāsaṅkappo.

56605.meaning1: to think; to conceive; to form an idea

examples.text: so yaṃ vitakkaṃ ākaṅkhati vitakketuṃ taṃ vitakkaṃ vitakketi, yaṃ vitakkaṃ nākaṅkhati vitakketuṃ na taṃ vitakkaṃ vitakketi, yaṃ saṅkappaṃ ākaṅkhati saṅkappetuṃ taṃ saṅkappaṃ saṅkappeti, yaṃ saṅkappaṃ nākaṅkhati saṅkappetuṃ na taṃ saṅkappaṃ saṅkappeti. iti cetovasippatto hoti vitakkapathe.

taṃ kiṃ maññasi, bhaddāli, idh'assa bhikkhu ubhatobhāgavimutto, tam'ahaṃ evaṃ vadeyyaṃ, ehi me tvaṃ, bhikkhu, paṅke saṅkamo hohī'ti, api nu kho so saṅkameyya vā aññena vā kāyaṃ sannāmeyya, no'ti vā vadeyyā'ti?

56609.meaning1: ?? goes across; (or) act as a bridge ??

examples.text: taṃ kiṃ maññasi, bhaddāli, idh'assa bhikkhu ubhatobhāgavimutto, tam'ahaṃ evaṃ vadeyyaṃ, ehi me tvaṃ, bhikkhu, paṅke saṅkamo hohī'ti, api nu kho so saṅkameyya vā aññena vā kāyaṃ sannāmeyya, no'ti vā vadeyyā'ti?

56610.meaning2: passage, bridge, going over, moving from place to place

examples.text: kāraye assame ramme, vāsay'ettha bahussute, papañ'ca vivane kayirā, dugge saṅkamanāni ca.

56614.commentary: (VINa) bhikkhunīhi saṅgamitun'ti bhikkhunīhi saddhiṃ saṅgamituṃ saṅgantuṃ samaṅgī bhavituṃ anujānāmī'ti attho.

56615.meaning2: having passed over to, having shifted, having transmigrated

56616.synonym: kampati, pariphandati, pavedhati, phandati, byathati, vikampati, vedhati, vedhatī, sampakampati, sampavedhati

examples.text: n'āhaṃ taṃ passāmi samaṇaṃ vā brāhmaṇaṃ vā, saṅghiṃ gaṇiṃ gaṇ'ācariyaṃ, api arahantaṃ sammāsambuddhaṃ paṭijānamānaṃ, yo mayā vādena vādaṃ samāraddho na saṅkampeyya na sampakampeyya na sampavedheyya, yassa na kacchehi sedā mucceyyuṃ.
ayañ'ca dasasahassī lokadhātu saṅkampi sampakampi sampavedhi appamāṇo ca oḷāro obhāso loke pāturahosi atikkamm'eva devānaṃ dev'ānubhāvaṃ.

atha kho te bhikkhū saṃviggā lomahaṭṭhajātā ekam'antaṃ aṭṭhaṃsu, acchariyaṃ vata, bho, abbhutaṃ vata, bho! nivātañ'ca vata ayañ'ca migāramātupāsādo gambhīranemo sunikhāto acalo asampakampī, atha ca pana saṅkampito sampakampito sampacālito'ti!

56620.meaning1: causes to shake; makes wobble; causes to tremble

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, bhante, selo pabbato acchiddo asusiro ekagghano. atha puratthimāya ce'pi disāya āgaccheyya bhusā vātavuṭṭhi n'eva naṃ saṅkampeyya na sampakampeyya na sampavedheyya

puratthimāya ce'pi disāya āgaccheyya samaṇo vā brāhmaṇo vā vād'atthiko vādagavesī, vādam'assa āropessāmī'ti, taṃ vata sahadhammena saṅkampessati vā sampakampessati vā sampacālessati vā'ti, n'etaṃ ṭhānaṃ vijjati.

56621.meaning1: could make shake; could wobble; could cause to tremble

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, bhante, selo pabbato acchiddo asusiro ekagghano. atha puratthimāya ce'pi disāya āgaccheyya bhusā vātavuṭṭhi n'eva naṃ saṅkampeyya na sampakampeyya na sampavedheyya

56622.meaning1: caused to shake; made wobble; caused to tremble

examples.text: atha kho āyasmā mahāmoggallāno tathārūpaṃ iddh'ābhisaṅkhāraṃ abhisaṅkhāsi yathā vejayantaṃ pāsādaṃ pād'aṅguṭṭhakena saṅkampesi sampakampesi sampavedhesi.

56628.meaning1: having gathered together; having banded together

examples.text: so manusse vadhitvā vadhitvā aṅgulīnaṃ mālaṃ dhāreti. etañ'hi, samaṇa, maggaṃ dasa'pi purisā vīsam'pi purisā tiṃsam'pi purisā cattārīsam'pi purisā paññāsam'pi purisā saṅkaritvā saṅkaritvā paṭipajjanti.

56631.commentary: (SNa) saṅkasāyatī'ti acchati. (SNa) saṅkasāyatī'ti viharati. (SNa) saṅkasāyatī'ti yassa dāni atthāya ahaṃ sajjhāyaṃ kareyyaṃ, so me attho matthakaṃ patto. kiṃ me idāni sajjhāyenāti phalasamāpattisukhena kālaṃ ativatteti. (ANa) tuṇhībhūtā saṅghamajjhe saṅkasāyantī'ti nissaddā hutvā saṅghamajjhe nisinnā kiñci ekavacanam'pi mukhaṃ ukkhipitvā kathetuṃ asakkontā pajjhāyantā viya nisīdanti.
56631.notes: BJT commentary has saṃkalāyati. (SaDM) saṃkase acchane. Sanskrit samīkṣate is one possible source this difficult word saṃ √īkṣ. Another possible explanation is a demonitive of kaṣāya in the sense of sticking like gum or resin.

examples.text: tasmiṃ, bhikkhave, samaye pesalā bhikkhū tuṇhībhūtā tuṇhībhūtā'va saṅghamajjhe saṅkasāyanti paccantime vā janapade acchanti.
addasā kho, bhikkhave, kummo kacchapo siṅgālaṃ dūrato'va gocarapasutaṃ. disvāna soṇḍipañcamāni aṅgāni sake kapāle samodahitvā app'ossukko tuṇhībhūto saṅkasāyati.

56633.meaning1: suspect; dodgy; doubtful; (comm) remembered with suspicion
56633.commentary: (SNa) saṅkassaran'ti saṅkāya saritaṃ, idam'pi iminā kataṃ bhavissati, idam'pi iminā'ti evaṃ āsaṅkitaparisaṅkitaṃ.
56633.notes: See PED, Cone and Edgerton for a variety of interpretations.

examples.text: yaṃ kiñci sithilaṃ kammaṃ, saṃkiliṭṭhañ'ca yaṃ vataṃ, saṅkassaraṃ brahmacariyaṃ, na taṃ hoti mahapphalaṃ.

addasā kho āyasmā mahāmoggallāno taṃ puggalaṃ dussīlaṃ pāpadhammaṃ asuciṃ saṅkassarasamācāraṃ paṭicchannakamm'antaṃ asamaṇaṃ samaṇapaṭiññaṃ abrahmacāriṃ brahmacāripaṭiññaṃ antopūtiṃ avassutaṃ kasambujātaṃ majjhe bhikkhusaṅghassa nisinnaṃ

56634.meaning1: remember with doubt; recollects with suspicion

56635.meaning1: of suspect behaviour; of dodgy conduct
56635.commentary: (SNa) saṅkassarasamācāro'ti imassa maññe imassa maññe idaṃ kamman'ti evaṃ parehi saṅkāya saritabbasamācāro. saṅkāya vā paresaṃ samācāraṃ saratī'ti'pi saṅkassarasamācāro. tassa hi dve tayo jane kathente disvā, mama dosaṃ maññe kathentī'ti tesaṃ samācāraṃ saṅkassara'ti dhāvatī'ti saṅkassarasamācāro.

examples.text: idha, bhikkhave, ekacco puggalo dussīlo hoti pāpadhammo asuci saṅkassarasamācāro paṭicchannakamm'anto, assamaṇo samaṇapaṭiñño, abrahmacārī brahmacāripaṭiñño, antopūti avassuto kasambujāto.

56636.meaning1: of suspect behaviour; of dodgy conduct

examples.text: sah'ācaritena chavo sigālo, na kotthuko sīhasamo kadāci, naggo musāvādī gaṇassa satthā, saṅkassar'ācāro na sataṃ sarikkho'ti.
ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā kosalesu cārikaṃ caramāno mahatā bhikkhusaṅghena saddhiṃ yena saṅkavā nāma kosalānaṃ nigamo tadavasari. tatra sudaṃ bhagavā saṅkavāyaṃ viharati.

56639.grammar: fem, abstr, in comps, from saṅkati
56639.commentary: (SNa) saṅkassaran'ti saṅkāya saritaṃ, idam'pi iminā kataṃ bhavissati, idam'pi iminā'ti evaṃ āsaṅkitaparisaṅkitaṃ.

examples.text: yaṃ kiñci sithilaṃ kammaṃ, saṃkiliṭṭhañ'ca yaṃ vataṃ, saṅkassaraṃ brahmacariyaṃ, na taṃ hoti mahapphalaṃ.

addasā kho āyasmā mahāmoggallāno taṃ puggalaṃ dussīlaṃ pāpadhammaṃ asuciṃ saṅkassarasamācāraṃ paṭicchannakamm'antaṃ asamaṇaṃ samaṇapaṭiññaṃ abrahmacāriṃ brahmacāripaṭiññaṃ antopūtiṃ avassutaṃ kasambujātaṃ majjhe bhikkhusaṅghassa nisinnaṃ

56641.commentary: (VVt) kiñci saṅkāmetī'ti kes'aggamattam'pi tato aññaṃ ṭhānaṃ pāpeti.

examples.text: yathā saṅkāraṭhānasmiṃ, ujjhitasmiṃ mahāpathe, padumaṃ tattha jāyetha, sucigandhaṃ manoramaṃ.
evaṃ saṅkārabhūtesu, andhabhūte puthujjane, atirocati paññāya, sammāsambuddhasāvako.
vīthi saṅkārakūṭesu, susāne rathiyāsu ca, acariṃ tīṇi vassāni, khuppipāsāsamappitā.
thero saṅkārakūṭamhā, uccinitvāna nantake, pilotikaṃ paṭaṃ katvā, saṅghe cātuddise adā.

seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, yaṃ yadeva paccayaṃ paṭicca aggi jalati tena ten'eva saṅkhyaṃ gacchati… thusañ'ca paṭicca aggi jalati, thus'aggitv'eva saṅkhyaṃ gacchati, saṅkārañ'ca paṭicca aggi jalati, saṅkār'aggitv'eva saṅkhyaṃ gacchati.

56649.meaning2: rag picked up from a rubbish heap

56650.meaning1: small piece of rag from a rubbish heap

examples.text: āyatanānaṃ nānattadassanena pana ayaṃ appanā, ahi nām'esa bahi sittasammaṭṭhe ṭhāne n'ābhiramati, saṅkāraṭṭhāna-tiṇapaṇṇagahana-vammikāni'y'eva pana pavisitvā nipannakāle abhiramati, ek'aggataṃ āpajjati.
yathā saṅkāraṭhānasmiṃ, ujjhitasmiṃ mahāpathe, padumaṃ tattha jāyetha, sucigandhaṃ manoramaṃ.
evaṃ saṅkārabhūtesu, andhabhūte puthujjane, atirocati paññāya, sammāsambuddhasāvako.

56654.meaning1: looking like; with the appearance of; resembling; similar to
56654.synonym: upanibha, nibha, paṭibhāga, patirūpaka, sannibha, sarūpa

examples.text: kālapabb'aṅgasaṅkāso, kiso dhamanisanthato, mattaññū annapānamhi, adīnamanaso naro.

56656.commentary: (SNa) saṅkāsanā'ti vibhattiyo. ekam'ekasmiñ'hi sacce sabb'ākārena vitthāriyamāne vaṇṇ'ādīnaṃ anto nāma n'atthi. tasmā evam'āha.

examples.text: tattha aparimāṇā vaṇṇā aparimāṇā byañjanā aparimāṇā saṅkāsanā, iti'p'idaṃ dukkhaṃ ariyasaccan'ti, idaṃ dukkhasamudayaṃ … idaṃ dukkhanirodhaṃ … idaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadā ariyasaccan'ti, bhikkhave, mayā paññattaṃ.

56658.meaning1: family name of an ascetic; Kisa Saṅkicca
56658.construction:
saṃ + √kar > kir + ti + ya
saṅkiti + ya

examples.text: kin'ti pana te, aggivessana, kāyabhāvanā sutā'ti? seyyath'idaṃ, nando vaccho, kiso saṅkicco, makkhali gosālo, etehi, bho gotama, acelakā mutt'ācārā hatth'āpalekhanā na-ehibhaddantikā natiṭṭhabhaddantikā na abhihaṭaṃ na uddissakataṃ na nimantanaṃ sādiyanti
tayo'me, bhikkhave, niruttipathā adhivacanapathā paññattipathā asaṅkiṇṇā asaṅkiṇṇapubbā, na saṅkīyanti, na saṅkīyissanti, appaṭikuṭṭhā samaṇehi brāhmaṇehi viññūhi. katame tayo?

56661.meaning1: who has filled the trench; who has covered the ditch

examples.text: sārajjaṃ saṅkito coro, sukhumālaṃ phāsu pañcamaṃ, ānanda sīlāsekhā ca, cātuddiso araññena cā'ti.

56664.commentary: (DNa) saṃkittīsū'ti saṃkittetvā katabhattesu, dubbhikkhasamaye kira acelakasāvakā acelakānaṃ atthāya tato tato taṇḍul'ādīni samādapetvā bhattaṃ pacanti. ukkaṭṭho acelako tato'pi na paṭiggaṇhati.

examples.text: na saṅkittīsu na yattha sā upaṭṭhito hoti na yattha makkhikā saṇḍasaṇḍacārinī, na macchaṃ na maṃsaṃ na suraṃ na merayaṃ na thus'odakaṃ pivanti.

56668.meaning1: should be suspected (of); could be doubted (regarding)
56668.commentary: (DNa) saṅkiyo ca hotī'ti aññehi katapāpakammesu'pi iminā kataṃ bhavissatī'ti saṅkitabbo hoti. yassa yassa gharadvārena yāti, tattha yaṃ aññena corakammaṃ paradārikakammaṃ vā kataṃ, taṃ iminā katan'ti vutte abhūtaṃ asantampi tasmiṃ rūhati patiṭṭhāti.

examples.text: akaronto'pi ce pāpaṃ, karontam'upasevati, saṅkiyo hoti pāpasmiṃ, avaṇṇo c'assa rūhati.

cha kho'me, gahapatiputta, ādīnavā vikālavisikhācariy'ānuyoge. attā'pi'ssa agutto arakkhito hoti, puttadāro'pi'ssa agutto arakkhito hoti, sāpateyyaṃ'pi'ssa aguttaṃ arakkhitaṃ hoti, saṅkiyo ca hoti pāpakesu ṭhānesu, abhūtavacanañ'ca tasmiṃ rūhati, bahūnañ'ca dukkhadhammānaṃ purakkhato hoti.

56669.meaning1: is doubted; is suspected; is open to suspicion

56670.commentary: (DNa) na saṅkīyantī'ti idāni'pi na apanīyanti. na saṅkīyissantī'ti anāgatabuddhehi'pi na apanīyissanti, ye loke viññū samaṇabrāhmaṇā, tehi appaṭikuṭṭhā, samaṇehi brāhmaṇehi viññūhi aninditā agarahitā.

56671.commentary: (DNa) saṅkiraṇan'ti uṭṭhānaṃ vā iṇaṃ vā dinnaṃ dhanaṃ ajja saṅkaḍḍhatha, ajja saṅkaḍḍhitañ'hi taṃ thāvaraṃ hotī'ti evaṃ dhanapiṇḍāpanaṃ.

examples.text: te evarūpāya tiracchānavijjāya micchājīvena jīvitaṃ kappenti. seyyath'idaṃ, āvāhanaṃ vivāhanaṃ saṃvaraṇaṃ vivaraṇaṃ saṅkiraṇaṃ vikiraṇaṃ subhagakaraṇaṃ dubbhagakaraṇaṃ viruddhagabbhakaraṇaṃ jivhānibandhanaṃ hanusaṃhananaṃ hatth'ābhijappanaṃ

56672.meaning1: tarnished; defiled; tainted; corrupted; impure; dirty
56672.meaning2: tarnished; defiled; tainted; corrupted; impure; dirty

examples.text: yaṃkiñci sithilaṃ kammaṃ, saṅkiliṭṭhañ'ca yaṃ vataṃ, saṅkassaraṃ brahmacariyaṃ, na taṃ hoti mahapphalan'ti
ettha rattā pamattā ca, saṅkiliṭṭhamanā narā, aññam'aññena byāruddhā, puthu kubbanti medhagaṃ.

56673.meaning1: with a defiled mind; with an impure heart; with a dirty mind
56673.commentary: (MNa) saṃkiliṭṭhacitto'ti tehi'y'eva suṭṭhutaraṃ kiliṭṭhacitto malīnacitto vibādhitacitto upatāpitacitto ca hutvā.

examples.text: saṅkiliṭṭhacitto vā asaṅkiliṭṭhacitto vā'ti? asaṅkiliṭṭhacitto, bho gotama.

56674.meaning1: more dirty; more tarnished; more stained
56674.commentary: (MNa) saṃkiliṭṭhatarā assa malaggahitā'ti ettha raj'āpathe nikkhipanena saṃkiliṭṭhatarā, aparibhogāpariyodapanehi malaggahitatarā'ti vuttaṃ hoti, paṭipucchāvacanañ'c'etaṃ.

examples.text: tam'enaṃ sāmikā na c'eva paribhuñjeyyuṃ na ca pariyodapeyyuṃ, raj'āpathe ca naṃ nikkhipeyyuṃ. evañ'hi sā, āvuso, kaṃsapāti aparena samayena saṅkiliṭṭhatarā assa malaggahitā'ti? evam'āvuso'ti.
idha pana, gahapati, ekacco, saṅkiliṭṭh'ābhā'ti pharitvā adhimuccitvā viharati.

56676.meaning1: is dirtied; is soiled; becomes impure (from)

examples.text: tasmā't'iha, bhikkhave, abhikkhaṇaṃ sakaṃ cittaṃ paccavekkhitabbaṃ, dīgharattam'idaṃ cittaṃ saṅkiliṭṭhaṃ rāgena dosena mohenā'ti. cittasaṅkilesā, bhikkhave, sattā saṅkilissanti. cittavodānā sattā visujjhanti.

56677.synonym: upakkilesa, kilesa, kelisa, klesa, paṅka, rajas, sandosa

examples.text: seyyath'idaṃ, dānakathaṃ sīlakathaṃ saggakathaṃ, kāmānaṃ ādīnavaṃ okāraṃ saṅkilesaṃ, nekkhamme ānisaṃsaṃ pakāsesi.
ummādanā ullapanā, kāmā cittappamaddino, sattānaṃ saṅkilesāya, khippaṃ mārena oḍḍitaṃ.

56678.meaning1: liable to defilement; of a corrupt nature

examples.text: katamā ca, bhikkhave, anariyā pariyesanā? idha, bhikkhave, ekacco… attanā sokadhammo samāno sokadhammaṃ'y'eva pariyesati, attanā saṅkilesadhammo samāno saṅkilesadhammaṃ'y'eva pariyesati.
saṅkiliṭṭhasaṅkilesikā dhammā. asaṅkiliṭṭhasaṅkilesikā dhammā. asaṅkiliṭṭh'āsaṅkilesikā dhammā.

56680.meaning1: subject to defilement; liable to corruption
56680.commentary: (SNa) saṃkilesikadhamman'ti saṃkilesikasabhāvaṃ. (VISM) taṇhādiṭṭhi-duccarita-saṃkilesānaṃ visayadhammatāya saṃkilesikadhammato'ti evaṃ pabhedato vuttassa anicc'ādisammasanassa vasena sammasati.

examples.text: sabbaṃ, bhikkhave, saṅkilesikadhammaṃ. kiñca, bhikkhave, sabbaṃ saṅkilesikadhammaṃ?

56682.commentary: (DNa) na saṅkīyantī'ti idāni'pi na apanīyanti. na saṅkīyissantī'ti anāgatabuddhehi'pi na apanīyissanti, ye loke viññū samaṇabrāhmaṇā, tehi appaṭikuṭṭhā, samaṇehi brāhmaṇehi viññūhi aninditā agarahitā.

examples.text: tayo'me, bhikkhave, niruttipathā adhivacanapathā paññattipathā asaṅkiṇṇā asaṅkiṇṇapubbā, na saṅkīyanti, na saṅkīyissanti, appaṭikuṭṭhā samaṇehi brāhmaṇehi viññūhi. katame tayo?

tena kho pana samayena sambahulā sakyā c'eva sakyakumārā ca sandh'āgāre uccesu āsanesu nisinnā honti aññam'aññaṃ aṅgulipatodakehi sañjagghantā saṅkīḷantā, añña'd'atthu mamaññ'eva maññe anujagghantā, na maṃ koci āsanena'pi nimantesi.
tassa kho pana, pāpima, mahānirayassa tayo nāmadheyyā honti, chaphass'āyataniko iti'pi, saṅkusamāhato iti'pi, paccattavedaniyo iti'pi.
varaṃ, bhikkhave, tiṇhena ayosaṅkunā ādittena sampajjalitena sajotibhūtena sot'indriyaṃ sampalimaṭṭhaṃ, na tv'eva sotaviññeyyesu saddesu anubyañjanaso nimittaggāho.
evaṃ maccharipuggalassa cittaṃ saṅkucati, tasmiṃ saṅkucite kāyo'pi tath'eva saṅkucati paṭikuṭati paṭinivaṭṭati na sampasārīyatī'ti maccheraṃ kaṭukañcukatā'ti vuttaṃ.
[saṃphuṭito'ti ettha saṅkucito'ti attho]

56690.meaning2: having become contracted, having shrunk, having clenched

56692.commentary: (DNa) saṅkuddho asayaṃ vase'ti suṭṭhu kuddho kupito kañci vase vattetuṃ asakkonto asayaṃvase asayaṃvasī attano vasena akāmako hutvā nivatto.

examples.text: yathā pāvussako megho, thanayanto savijjuko, tadā so paccudāvatti, saṅkuddho asayaṃvase.

56693.meaning2: path to be gone with the help of stakes

examples.text: ubhinnam'atthaṃ carati, attano ca parassa ca, paraṃ saṅkupitaṃ ñatvā, yo sato upasammati.

seyyathā'pi, ānanda, āsabhacammaṃ saṅkusatena suvihataṃ vigatavalikaṃ, evam'eva kho, ānanda, bhikkhu yaṃ imissā pathaviyā ukkūlavikkūlaṃ nadīviduggaṃ khāṇukaṇṭakaṭṭhānaṃ pabbatavisamaṃ taṃ sabbaṃ amanasikaritvā pathavīsaññaṃ paṭicca manasi karoti ekattaṃ.

56698.meaning1: hell of the iron stakes being struck together; epithet of the great hell

examples.text: tassa kho pana, pāpima, mahānirayassa tayo nāmadheyyā honti, chaphass'āyataniko iti'pi, saṅkusamāhato iti'pi, paccattavedaniyo iti'pi.
theyyasaṅkhātan'ti ādiyeyyā'ti ādiyeyya hareyya avahareyya iriyāpathaṃ vikopeyya ṭhānā cāveyya saṅketaṃ vītināmeyya.
